items.title: Will Jensen Huang's second act as Nvidia CEO be different?
items.summary: In the Loop host Ejaaz Ahamadeen takes a look at the Nvidia (NVDA) leadership saga as Jensen Huang steps back into his CEO role. Ahamadeen explores how Huang's leadership style and strategic vision could evolve in his second act, and why the outlook for the AI chip giant remains bright.

items.title: Jensen Huang 'absolutely could be fired again,' legal expert says
items.summary: Gil Soffer of Katten Soffer speaks with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi about how the investigation into Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang could take, whether he could shut it down, and the worst-case outcomes he faces.

items.title: 5 things I'm thankful for in AI
items.summary: Happy Thanksgiving. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen counts five things he's grateful for in AI: Jensen Huang back at Nvidia, open-source AI back on the table, Google breaking up the two-horse race, Anthropic's record-breaking IPO and how fast AI is getting smarter and cheaper. Then he gets to the part that worries him.

items.title: Alphabet Could Be the Safest Way to Own Anthropic. Here’s the Math.
items.summary: Alphabet owns a piece of Anthropic and also gets paid to supply its computing power, which is a nice way to be on both sides of the AI boom.

items.title: Dow Jones Futures Rise With U.S. Markets Shut; Look For This Bullish Signal
items.summary: Futures are rising with U.S. markets shut after a wild session in which the Nasdaq rallied off lows while the Dow Jones and Anthropic reversed higher.

items.title: NVIDIA Stocks Fall 3.91% as S&P Puts AA Rating on Downgrade Watch
items.summary: A governance review after Jensen Huang's exit and return now threatens a one-notch cut, while Moody's keeps its Aa1 rating steady.

items.title: Nvidia faces credit rating review as S&P flags governance concerns
items.summary: S&P Global Ratings has placed Nvidia Corp (NASDAQ:NVDA, XETRA:NVD)'s AA credit rating on negative watch, citing concerns over corporate governance, board independence and the company’s reliance on CEO Jensen Huang.
